info.name: Pisto API
info.description: Every Pisto HTTP endpoint, ordered as one end-to-end run against a local API. Run the whole collection in order with a 1000 ms delay between requests (the API allows 60 writes per minute per user): it creates a new demo account and business each time, stores ids in collection variables and asserts each response. Set `baseUrl` (API origin) and `webOrigin` (an origin listed in CORS_ORIGINS and TRUSTED_ORIGINS) in the environment. Sessions use the HttpOnly `pisto.session_token` cookie, which Postman keeps automatically.

exec: // Demo businesses use America/El_Salvador, which is UTC-6 all year (no daylight saving).

03 Catalog
item.description: Categories and products. Names and SKUs are unique per business; records are archived, never deleted.

item.name: 04 Inventory
item.description: Append-only stock movements for tracked products. On-hand stock is derived and can never go negative.

item.name: 05 Cash
item.description: Cash accounts with derived balances, manual adjustments, one-time reversals and paired transfers.

item.name: Create cash account with opening balance
List cash movements of an account

exec: pm.test("adjustment is in the ledger", () => pm.expect(json.data.items.map((m) => m.id)).to.include(pm.collectionVariables.get("adjustmentMovementId")));

item.name: 06 Expenses
item.description: Paid expenses post their cash movement atomically; voiding reverses both.

exec: pm.test("only the posted expense is listed", () => pm.expect(json.data.items.map((e) => e.id)).to.eql([pm.collectionVariables.get("expenseId")]));

item.name: 07 Sales
item.description: Total-only sales with idempotent confirmation, server-owned review, history and void/replace corrections. Amounts are integer minor units as strings ("1250" = $12.50).

item.name: Reused key with another amount is rejected
Replace sale with a corrected amount
08 Customers and receivables
item.description: Customers, credit charges, payments into a cash account, one-time payment reversals and voids.

item.name: Create customer rejects an invalid email

09 Reports
item.description: Exact operating report for a business-local date range, computed in one read-only transaction.

exec: pm.test("range error is explained", () => pm.expect(json.error.message).to.eql("Operating report range is invalid"));

item.name: 10 Billing (disabled locally)
item.description: Billing adapters exist but BILLING_ENABLED and REVENUECAT_ENABLED are false by default; these requests assert the disabled contract.

item.name: Polar webhook is not mounted while billing is disabled
11 Itemized sales
item.description: A counter sale with products: stock leaves inventory, the amount received enters one account and any balance becomes the customer's receivable, all in one idempotent command.

exec: pm.test("total is quantity times the catalog price", () => pm.expect(json.data.sale.grossMinorUnits).to.eql(String(2n * BigInt(json.data.lines[0].unitPriceMinorUnits))));

item.name: Record itemized sale again (same key replays)
Selling more than the stock is refused
A balance on credit needs a customer
12 Suppliers, purchases and payables
item.description: Suppliers, purchases on cash or credit that enter stock, supplier payments up to the balance and the accounts payable summary.

item.name: Credit purchase needs a due date
Paying more than the balance is refused
A purchase with payments cannot be voided
Void the cash purchase (stock and money return)
13 Movements, home and settings
item.description: Reads behind the home and the unified ledger: money trend, movements of every kind with period totals, debtors, monthly cash flow, low stock and the role policy.

exec: pm.test("lists sales, purchases and payments", () => { const kinds = json.data.items.map((m) => m.kind); ["sale", "purchase", "supplier_payment"].forEach((k) => pm.expect(kinds).to.include(k)); });

item.name: 14 AI assistant
item.description: The registration assistant turns one sentence into a draft the user reviews; it never saves a record. Locally it answers 503 unless Workers AI credentials are configured; the hosted Worker uses the AI binding.

exec: if (pm.response.code === 200) { const json = pm.response.json(); pm.test("drafts an expense of $18.00", () => { pm.expect(json.data.interpretation.draft.kind).to.eql("expense"); pm.expect(json.data.interpretation.draft.amountMinorUnits).to.eql("1800"); }); }

item.name: 15 Security and error handling
item.description: Negative checks: strict queries, hidden identifiers, origin policy, content type and session revocation.
